title: Characterization and functional analysis of cathelicidin-MH, a novel frog-derived peptide with anti-septicemic properties.

materials_exhausted.supplementary_assets_note: OA package DOCX supplements 1-6 were parsed with stdlib OOXML; landed supplementary .bin/.php files are landing HTML wrappers, while the OA package contains the true DOCX supplements.
materials_exhausted.figure_assets_note: Relevant figure-image tables/panels were opened directly for MIC and toxicity/mechanism evidence.

summary: Source-reviewed rework recovered the missing activity rows, reconciled linked APD6/DBAASP records against primary figures/sections, and closed the prior review ticket with nonblocking cautions preserved.
adjudication_summary: The paper is publication-grade after bounded re-review: worker-2 recovered figure-backed MIC/toxicity records, worker-4 resolved database row statuses with one preserved taxonomy caution, and worker-6 verified final provenance and no remaining targeted rework.

per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Material packet remains the structural source inventory; primary XML/PDF, OA package figures, DOCX supplements, and merged database rows were reopened rather than trusting the framework summary.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Validator/packet presence was treated as structural readiness only; acceptance was not based on the initial complete-message test.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: APD6:AP03270 and DBAASP:DBAASPR_18216 share a source-supported mature cath-MH sequence. MIC/hemolysis database rows now have primary locators; the P. acnes/C. acnes taxonomy mismatch is retained as a nonblocking source_conflict.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Seven MIC records were recovered from Figure 3-figure supplement 1A, with time-kill and toxicity context from source figure/sections; database-only activity text is not used as primary evidence.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are source-located and bounded to membrane assays, LPS binding/neutralization, protease/coagulation assays, and in vivo sepsis context without overclaiming beyond the assays.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: The prior blocking issues are closed; remaining cautions are explicit and do not require targeted rework.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP uses Cutibacterium acnes ATCC 6919; primary Figure 3-figure supplement 1A uses Propionibacterium acnes ATCC 6919 with the same MIC value and strain.
APD6 entry text aggregates sequence/activity/toxicity/mechanism statements; primary locators are used for final row-level evidence.
Figure-only plotted LPS/stability/toxicity panels were inspected for context; exact graph-point digitization was not needed for the linked MIC/hemolysis database rows.
